statement: The post-run full-output replay source passes 33 feature tests and six default tests and builds successfully. Tests compare all completed answers and production-consumer receipts from both retained F127 full-output suites, reject six altered records including a lost unconsumed row whose counts remain structurally consistent, and preserve failed-oracle/skipped-draw incomplete outcomes. This is unsigned local software qualification using shared fixture/reference/consumer source, not independent signed validation.
